snippet.title: Super Mario Kart Deluxe (#SMKDX) - Release Date Announcement Teaser
snippet.description:
Release Date Announcement Teaser for Super Mario Kart Deluxe!

-------------------------------------------
🌟 Features of SMKDX 🌟
-------------------------------------------
⍟ Works On Original Hardware!
⍟ 8 Additional Characters (16 Total)
    ⋆ Wario, Daisy, Bowser Jr, Kamek
    ⋆ Waluigi, Birdo, Dixie Kong, and Toadette
⍟ 8 Additional Track Themes (16 Total)
    ⋆ Daisy Garden, Desert Land, Hazy Cavern, Fiery Volcano, 
    ⋆ Wario Rally, Stormy Jungle, Poison Swamp, and Star Road
⍟ 6 Additional Cups (10 Total), with Unique Podium Scenes
⍟ 50 Race Tracks + 10 Battle Tracks
⍟ Mirror Mode for All Tracks
⍟ Mission Mode, with 81 Mission Levels and Custom Bosses
⍟ Settings Menu
⍟ Custom Item Enable/Disable and Custom Item Probabilities
⍟ New Game Modes: 
    ⋆ Shine Thief, Gate Battle, Battle Race and more
⍟ 6 Speed Classes: 50cc, 100cc, 150cc, 200cc, 250cc, and 300cc!!
⍟ New Music and Sound Effects
⍟ New Items
    ⋆ CPU-only items (Egg, Fireball, and Poison Mushroom) can now be used by the player
    ⋆ Blue Shell, Yellow Shell, Blooper, P-Ballon and many other make their way to SMK 
⍟ New Track Obstacles (including our beloved swimming friend Dorrie)
⍟ Staff Ghosts
⍟ Custom Credits
⍟ Custom Input Viewer and Speedometer

-------------------
🌟 Q&A 🌟
-------------------
Q: Will this game be working on Super Nintendo/Super Famicom or only on emulators?
A: Yes, the romhack will be fully working on original hardware as well as emulators. Also, both PAL and NTSC versions of the game will be available.

Q: How can I have more information about this game/remain aware of the progress?
A: Follow us (MrL314 and ScouB) and/or SMKWorkshop team (See at the bottom of Description for links). We publish regularly about our progress on the game.
